$bog_doodle_land_Faq_data_text: Only on your device. Nothing is uploaded unless you share a link yourself.
$bog_doodle_land_Faq_devices_head: Which devices does it run on?
$bog_doodle_land_Faq_devices_text: Any modern browser: phone, tablet with a pen, laptop. Install it from the browser menu to use it like an app.
$bog_doodle_land_Faq_free_text: Yes. No ads, no subscription, no locked features. The code is open under the MIT license.
$bog_doodle_land_Faq_music_head: Do I need to know music theory?
$bog_doodle_land_Faq_music_text: No. Pick a mood and draw. The notes always come from the chosen scale, so nothing sounds off.
$bog_doodle_land_Feature_color_text: Pick any color from a full picker. Its hue chooses the instrument: piano, pluck, pad, marimba, lead or bell.
$bog_doodle_land_Feature_export_text: Save your piece as WAV audio, a MIDI file for your DAW, or a PNG picture. No watermark, no paywall.
$bog_doodle_land_Feature_layers_text: Keep bass and melody on separate layers. Chain patterns into verse and chorus and let the editor follow the music.
$bog_doodle_land_Feature_moods_text: Pick a mood from calm to cyberpunk and the scale, tempo, swing and instrument are set for you.
$bog_doodle_land_Feature_music_text: One axis is time, the other is pitch. Lines snap to the notes of the key you picked, so everything sounds right.
$bog_doodle_land_Feature_offline_text: Install it to your home screen. Drawings stay on your device, the app runs without a network.
$bog_doodle_land_Feature_pen_text: Pen pressure, smooth strokes, brush and eraser sizes, selection, undo, zoom and pan, palm rejection for tablets.
$bog_doodle_land_Feature_share_text: The whole drawing fits into a link. Send it and your friend hears and edits it, no server and no sign up.
$bog_doodle_land_Step_draw_text: Waves, dots, zigzags. Press harder for louder, change color for a new instrument.
$bog_doodle_land_Step_mood_text: Calm, blues, pixel game or baroque. It sets the key, scale and tempo.
$bog_doodle_land_Step_play_text: Hit play, stack patterns into a song, export WAV or MIDI, or send a link.
